summary: Zentek Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an October 5, 2026 press release announcing that CEO Mohammed Jiwan was invited to present Albany graphite purification results at the 26th International Nuclear Graphite Specialists Meeting in Osaka on October 22, 2026. Bench-scale acid-free purification reached up to 99.99985 wt.% carbon (5N+) without hydrofluoric acid. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is an operational and scientific update, not a special situation; watch for qualification milestones and pre-feasibility study progress.
